chunks.rationale: Start with electron/test/config-doctor.test.js — it pins the six-axis rubric, memory coverage, generate-from-memory selection (convention/strategy/verified knowledge; no tasks/runs), write-path confinement, and the services layer (unknown project, missing checkout, memory-down lint vs generate). Then test/memoryTab.test.tsx for the confirm-before-write UI.
risks: Scoring tests pin specific axis numbers; a rubric tweak will fail them on purpose.
Renderer tests do not mount the full AgentsPanel wiring — that lives in the impl chunk.

chunks.rationale: electron/configDoctor.js is the whole feature: discover files, score, generate, write. Read score* then selectSourceEntries/renderGeneratedMarkdown then assertWriteableRel/writeAgentConfigFiles. electron/services.js requireLocalProject + loadConfigSourceEntries is the fail-closed checkout/memory seam.
risks: Heuristic scores can mis-grade unusual but good files (a one-line 'never do X' convention file will look sparse).
Write overwrites AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md in the project checkout with no backup; the UI confirms, but there is no .bak.
Remote SSH projects with no local directory throw 'needs a local checkout' — intended, but the Memory tab will just show that error.
Generation is a template, not an LLM rewrite. It will not invent Commands/Architecture sections the memory never stored.

chunks.rationale: IPC/preload/wire/fakeCoder/devCoder/useCoder/App/AgentsPanel are the usual fan-out. MemoryTab ConfigDoctorCard is the only new UI. memory-proxy now forwards recent({type}) so generate can pull conventions without a mixed recent() page.
risks: devCoder write throws (browser-dev only); lint/preview are stubs and will not match electron.
Doctor card is hidden when the memory server is down (MemoryTab early-return). Lint could still run without memory, but generate cannot.
Session-end auto-learning from Anthropic's plugin is explicitly not here — that is #247.
Fleet-wide rollup of every project's grade is not here; this is per-repo, on the Memory tab.
